text:
Half a bagel with cream cheese on a square plate (about 22 cm across). The bagel half is roughly 8–9 cm in diameter. A half bagel weighs about 50 g, plus about 20 g of cream cheese, for roughly 70 g total. Energy: about 130 kcal for the bagel half and 70 kcal for the cream cheese, giving about 200 kcal.
